channel.title: The Grant Desk - weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

    Youth Music · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.
  • Delfina Foundation: Open Call for Curators Based in Central and West Africa (London residency)
    https://www.delfinafoundation.com/open-calls/current/open-call-for-curators-based-in-central-and-west-africa/
    Delfina Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Fully supported: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials and research allowance of GBP 70 per week, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. Supported by Delfina Foundation's Network of Patrons for Africa. No application fee.
  • Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • Dot Line Space Art Foundation: Water Bodies & Ecology 2026 (Mumbai)
    https://www.dotlinespace.co.in/water-bodies-and-ecology-2026/
    Dot Line Space Art Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Grants towards travel and production expenses for selected artists. The call does not publish fixed amounts and does not state an artist fee or accommodation. No application fee.
  • Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.
  • University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
    https://arts.uj.ac.za/artists-in-residence/
    UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.
  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    https://arty-farty.typeform.com/to/xnDikGGM
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No submission fee.
  • Inato Gallery: Touch Some Grass (open-call poster exhibition)
    https://www.inatogallery.com/open-call
    Inato Gallery · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No artist fee, stipend or production budget. This is an exhibition opportunity: selected posters are shown in Inato Gallery's Touch Some Grass exhibition. No submission fee is stated in the call.
  • DRIFT: Choreographer Open Call 2026-27 (Dance and Research In The Future Time)
    https://driftdance.eu/artists/open-call
    DRIFT, a four-year Creative Europe cooperation of ten organisations led by Theatre de Liege and Maison de la danse · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · EUR 20,000 research budget per choreographer, covering artistic fees, travel, accommodation and optional collaborator costs. Also included: an Onboarding Lab, two weeks of residency with your national DRIFT partner, three collaborative Online Labs, a Festival Lab in Tunis, individual artistic mentoring and individual curatorial mentoring, and a work-in-progress presentation at the Biennale de la danse in Lyon. No application fee.
  • Surel's Place: Month-Long Artist Residency (September 2026 deadline)
    https://surelsplace.org/month-long-residencies/
    Surel's Place · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Free rent, utilities and wi-fi, a living stipend of USD 100 per week, a USD 300 travel stipend, use of well-maintained bicycles, free or discounted tickets to art events and movies, marketing through Surel's Place channels, and event hosting including logistics and installation help. Each resident also gets a local host to orient them and host their public events. No application fee. NOTE: Surel's Place takes a commission on sales arising from the residency, 35% of retail price on artwork, 45% on ticketed events that are offsite or need contracted services (calculated after administrative expenses), and 15% on books, CDs or other merchandise tangential to the artist's medium. A surcharge may apply to cover additional utility costs if a partner joins.
  • ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
    Arts Council England · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
  • Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline Closed 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Voucher Art Event, Mexico Art Week 2027
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/voucher-art-event-mexico-art-week-2027/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Closed 10 Sep 2026 · A voucher covering admission to the Zona Maco preview days, a curated programme during Mexico Art Week 2027, a networking event with the Dutch Embassy, and hotel accommodation from 2 to 7 February 2027, plus a EUR 1,300 contribution towards travel costs. 15 vouchers are available. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: International Collaborative Projects with Heritage Institutes (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/international-collaborative-projects-with-heritage-institutes/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Closed 10 Sep 2026 · Determined per application. Up to 40% of variable project costs. For a development research phase, up to 70% of variable costs capped at EUR 15,000, covering travel, accommodation and presentation costs. The applicant must contribute significantly to the project financing, and the international partners' cost share must be proportional to the Mondriaan Fund grant. No application fee.
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.fondsbjp.nl/subsidies/
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline Closed 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Heritage Innovation (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/heritage-innovation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Closed 17 Sep 2026 · Projects: up to 40% of variable project-related costs, with a minimum project budget of EUR 25,000. Research tracks: up to 70% of costs, capped at EUR 15,000, with no minimum budget. No application fee.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline Closed 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline Closed 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • La Résidence du Festival de Cannes (Cinéma de Demain): Screenwriting Residency in Paris
    https://cinemadedemain.festival-cannes.com/en/take-part/register-to-the-residence/
    Festival de Cannes (Cinéma de Demain / La Résidence) · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · Fully supported: a place of residence in central Paris, a personalised script-writing programme, and a collective programme of forums with film industry professionals. Directors present at the CNC pavilion in Cannes, where the CNC awards a EUR 5,000 grant to one director per session. Free to apply.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Acquisitions (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/acquisitions/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Maximum 40% of the estimated acquisition value, determined per application from the budget. The estimated value of the object must exceed EUR 50,000, and the applicant must contribute significantly to the acquisition costs. Applications requesting over EUR 500,000 are referred to the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science. No application fee.
  • Physical AI Safety Institute: Research Fellowship (expression of interest)
    https://airtable.com/appYKevtFovAswTXz/pagtcy2ye0OeFf04d/form
    Physical AI Safety Institute (PAISI) · deadline Rolling / undated · Stipend amount is not published. Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact. Free to submit an expression of interest.
  • British Council Travel Grant Fund (film and XR, rolling)
    https://film.britishcouncil.org/opportunities/travel-grants-fund
    British Council, supported by BFI National Lottery funding in partnership with BFI NETWORK and the BFI International Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by strand: short and feature film festival grants GBP 150 to 1,500 (typically up to GBP 750); XR travel-only grants GBP 150 to 1,500; large XR grants GBP 1,500 to 5,000; lab grants capped at GBP 6,000; co-production forum grants capped at GBP 2,000. Free to apply.
  • ESA Open Space Innovation Platform (OSIP): rolling open call for ideas
    https://www.esa.int/Enabling_Support/Preparing_for_the_Future/Discovery_and_Preparation/The_Open_Space_Innovation_Platform_OSIP
    European Space Agency (ESA) · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by route and campaign. Successful ideas are supported through PhD or postdoctoral research co-funded by ESA and universities, early technology development activities, or system studies. Free to submit.
  • AIXI Labs: Research Fellowship (rolling, quarterly rounds)
    https://www.aixi.uk/team/opportunities/aixi-labs-fellowship/
    AIXI Labs · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 2,000 to GBP 3,500 per month stipend, plus a compute budget for machine-learning work. Free to apply.
  • ESWA Digital Rights Gathering 2026: The (W)horrors Edition (Barcelona)
    https://www.eswalliance.org/digital_rights_gathering2026
    European Sex Workers' Rights Alliance (ESWA) · deadline Rolling / undated · PARTICIPANTS: fully funded, with travel, accommodation and food covered for all selected participants. SESSION FACILITATORS: EUR 300 per 90-minute session, plus travel, accommodation and meals covered. Free to apply.
  • Luminos.AI Legal Engineering Fellowship (Fall 2026)
    https://www.luminos.ai/jobs/luminos-ai-fellowship-program-fall-2026
    Luminos.AI · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 35 per hour, part-time. No application fee.
  • Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

item.title: 31 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Twente: Postdoc, Multimodal Conversational AI for Cultural Heritage
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362707/postdoc-position-on-multimodal-conversational-ai-for-cultural-heritage/
    University of Twente, Human Media Interaction group · deadline Closed 16 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,546 to 5,538 gross per month for 40 hours per week (8 salary steps, depending on experience), plus standard Dutch university holiday and year-end allowances.
  • ProPublica Emerging Reporters Program 2026-2027
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/propublica/jobs/4577283006
    ProPublica · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · $9,000 stipend, paid as two instalments of $4,500 (one at the start of the programme, one at the midpoint), plus a fully funded journalism conference trip with accommodation and expenses covered. No application fee.
  • Trusted Creator Fellowship 2026 (News Creator Corps)
    https://newscreatorcorps.org/programs/trusted-creator/apply/
    News Creator Corps (a project of the Good Information Foundation) · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · $5,000 stipend on completing the programme. No application fee.
  • Sundance Collab x Merrell: Brand-Supported Storytelling Program 2026
    https://collab.sundance.org/catalog/Merrell-Brand-Supported-Storytelling-Program
    Sundance Collab (Sundance Institute) in collaboration with Merrell · deadline Closed 18 Aug 2026 · USD 20,000 production budget per selected filmmaker to make and deliver the greenlit concept, cutdowns (:06, :15, :30) and stills. Includes an online brand-supported storytelling program, and a covered hotel stay for one participant to attend the Sundance Film Festival in January 2027. No application fee.
  • University of Amsterdam: PhD, Protest and Political Speech in the Nordics 1930-1970 (Sound of Disagreement)
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362349/phd-position-on-protest-and-political-speech-in-the-nordics-1930-1970/
    University of Amsterdam (UvA), Faculty of Humanities, Department of European Studies · deadline Closed 20 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 38 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus. No application fee.
  • AI Builders Fellowship 2026 (Internet Archive Canada x BC + AI)
    https://bc-ai.ca/fellowship
    Internet Archive Canada (IAC) in partnership with BC + AI · deadline Closed 21 Aug 2026 · $5,000 award for one selected builder. No application fee.
  • Collider: Program Manager (AI safety fieldbuilding, New York)
    https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cP3r4slpewE6_5wsJQYTPAg_qKsRX4WYDSy7bfYxMd0/preview
    Collider · deadline Closed 23 Aug 2026 · USD 150,000 to 180,000 base salary, plus health insurance, 401(k) and 20 days paid time off. The one-day in-person work trial is paid.
  • Sundance Institute: Episodic Program and Lab 2027
    https://filmfreeway.com/SundanceEpisodicLab2027
    Sundance Institute · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · No stipend or honorarium for participation. For the in-person Lab, Sundance covers round-trip basic economy airfare from the airport nearest the fellow's residence, shared housing with a private room and bath, and ground transport to and from the airport (fellows within 100 miles of the Lab get ground transport only). Meals, in-room charges, travel insurance, luggage fees and taxes are the fellow's own cost. One selected project also receives a separate monetary grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation for a series with an illuminating emphasis on science, including medicine, energy, technology or invention. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 nonrefundable processing fee per project submitted.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Inside-Out Art Museum Residency 2027 (Beijing)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/subsidie-aanvragen/regelingen/residency/inside-out-art-museum-beijing-china/
    Mondriaan Fund / Inside-Out Art Museum · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 8,478 for an artist or EUR 5,622 for a curator/critic toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Inside-Out Art Museum support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. For a selected duo the total is increased proportionally to cover the second applicant's travel and accommodation. Contribution for Caribbean-based residents can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.
  • Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
  • Helpmann Fellowships 2026
    https://helpmannacademy.com.au/helpmann-fellowships/
    Helpmann Academy · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to AUD 7,500 per fellowship, three fellowships available. Supported by the James & Diana Ramsay Foundation. No application fee.
  • University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Rotterdam: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, September 2026 round)
    https://www.rotterdam.nl/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Rotterdam (Municipality of Rotterdam) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · No stated per-application cap. Annual pot EUR 1,632,000 split into six rounds of EUR 272,000, with roughly 130 applications per round. Discipline sub-caps: book writing max EUR 4,500; moving image R&D max EUR 4,000; moving-image production max EUR 12,500; post-production max EUR 4,000. Applicants must demonstrably seek other funds or sponsors. Awards over EUR 50,000 require an auditor's statement at reporting, at the applicant's cost. No application fee.
  • Kunstraad Groningen: Two-Year Programme Scheme (Tweejarige Programmaregeling, 2027-2028)
    https://kunstraadgroningen.nl/subsidies/tweejarige-programmaregeling/
    Kunstraad Groningen, on behalf of the municipality and province of Groningen · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 40,000 maximum per year across two years, so up to EUR 80,000 total. Covers a maximum of one third of total project costs, requiring roughly 67 percent co-financing. Annual scheme budget EUR 325,000. No application fee.
  • JUGAAD: Absolute Improvisation, open call for printed matter and small-format works (Amsterdam)
    https://sacartamsterdam.com/upcoming-programmes/
    SAC Art Amsterdam and Mama Magnet · deadline Closed 05 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Selected work is sold at the printed matter fair on mutually agreeable terms regarding commission, duration and number of editions; artists are remunerated within 30 days of each sale. Unsold works are returned at the end of the agreed consignment period.
  • Utrecht University: PhD, Media and Democracy in the 1970s (NWO Vidi project)
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362200/phd-media-and-democracy-in-the-1970s/
    Utrecht University, Faculty of Humanities, Department of History and Art History · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 36 to 40 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus. No application fee.
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline Closed 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline Closed 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
  • Kone Foundation: Annual Grant Call (2026)
    https://koneensaatio.fi/en/grants/grantapplicants/criteria-for-applying/
    Kone Foundation / Koneen Saatio (Finland) · deadline Closed 15 Sep 2026 · Artistic groups and organisations up to EUR 250,000; research groups typically EUR 200,000 to 500,000. Minimum project duration six months for individual applicants and one month for groups; maximum four consecutive years for the same project. No co-financing requirement stated. No application fee. No retroactive funding.
  • Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline Closed 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline Closed 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline Closed 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung: Project Funding (October 2026 round)
    https://evs-musikstiftung.ch/en/project-funding/application/
    Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung · deadline Closed 01 Oct 2026 · No published minimum or maximum. Primarily covers artistic costs, not overheads. The Foundation explicitly will not fully fund a project, and requires at least one other institution to participate financially at a level similar to the amount requested, functioning as a de facto 1:1 match. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline Closed 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Pilot Contribution (Pilotbijdrage, 2026-2027, rolling)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/pilotbijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL (successor to Kickstart Cultuurfonds) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 75,000. Covers pilot development, audience testing, and knowledge development or training via partner organisations if budgeted. Hardware-only purchases are not eligible. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee. Annual donation budget of EUR 1.9 million in 2026 and 2027.
  • Brabant C: ASML x Brabant C Project Scheme (2026-2027, rolling)
    https://www.brabantc.nl/asml-x-brabant-c-project/
    Brabant C (Provincie Noord-Brabant culture investment fund) in partnership with ASML · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 25,000 minimum, up to EUR 500,000. Contribution capped at 50 percent of total project budget, so 50 percent co-financing is mandatory. EUR 1.7 million available per year, split evenly between ASML and Brabant C. Requests at or above EUR 50,000 must include a future-viability plan. No application fee.
  • Het Cultuurfonds: Ontwikkelbijdrage for Individual Makers and Collectives (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.cultuurfonds.nl/aanvragen/individuele-aanvragen
